meta.description: Qué cookies y tecnologías de almacenamiento usa BlockMiner, para qué, y cómo controlar tus preferencias.

cookiePolicy.title: Política de Cookies
cookiePolicy.intro: Esta Política de Cookies explica cómo BlockMiner (“nosotros”) usa cookies y tecnologías similares (localStorage, sessionStorage) en blockminer.space, y cómo puedes controlar estas preferencias.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. Qué son las cookies
paragraphs: Las cookies son pequeños archivos de texto que un sitio guarda en tu navegador. Permiten que el sitio recuerde información entre visitas o durante tu sesión — como mantenerte conectado, recordar tus preferencias o entender cómo se usa el sitio.
Además de cookies, también usamos localStorage y sessionStorage (almacenamiento local del navegador) con fines similares; tratamos ambos con el mismo cuidado descrito aquí.

howWeUseThem.title: 2. Cómo usamos las cookies
paragraphs: Usamos cookies y almacenamiento local para tres fines: (1) mantener tu sesión autenticada y proteger la plataforma contra ataques (esenciales); (2) recordar preferencias como el idioma (funcionales); y (3) medir el rendimiento de campañas de marketing, cuando das tu consentimiento (analítica/publicidad).

essentialCookies.title: 3. Cookies estrictamente necesarias
paragraphs: Estas cookies son indispensables para el funcionamiento seguro de la plataforma y no se pueden desactivar en nuestra configuración — desactivarlas en el navegador impide iniciar sesión o compromete la seguridad de la cuenta.
bullets: blockminer_access — token de sesión (JWT), te mantiene autenticado.
blockminer_refresh — token de renovación de sesión, usado para emitir un nuevo acceso sin pedirte iniciar sesión de nuevo.
blockminer_csrf — token anti-CSRF, protege contra acciones falsificadas en tu nombre por otro sitio.
blockminer_admin_session — sesión separada usada solo en el panel de administración.

functionalCookies.title: 4. Cookies y almacenamiento funcionales
paragraphs: Mejoran la experiencia pero no son estrictamente indispensables.
bullets: i18nextLng (localStorage) — recuerda el idioma que elegiste.
blockminer_utm (sessionStorage) — guarda los parámetros UTM de tu visita durante la sesión, para saber de qué campaña viniste.
Preferencia de tema claro/oscuro, cuando corresponda.

analyticsAdvertisingCookies.title: 5. Cookies de analítica y publicidad (con consentimiento)
paragraphs: Solo cargamos estas cookies/scripts después de que aceptas en el banner de cookies. Si rechazas, nunca se cargan ni se guardan.
bullets: Meta Pixel (_fbp, _fbc) — mide la eficacia de campañas en Facebook/Instagram y permite anuncios más relevantes, cuando está configurado.
Google Analytics (_ga y similares) — métricas de uso agregadas, cuando está configurado.

thirdPartyCookies.title: 6. Cookies de terceros
paragraphs: Algunas funciones incorporan servicios de terceros que pueden establecer sus propias cookies cuando se usan: Cloudflare Turnstile (verificación anti-bot en inicio de sesión/registro), WalletConnect/Reown (conexión de billetera Web3) y reproductores de video incorporados (YouTube) en la sección de tareas. Estos servicios tienen sus propias políticas de cookies, que no controlamos.

yourChoices.title: 7. Tus opciones
paragraphs: Al visitar el sitio por primera vez, un banner te permite Aceptar o Rechazar cookies no esenciales. Las cookies estrictamente necesarias (sesión, seguridad) siempre se usan, ya que sin ellas el sitio no funciona. Puedes cambiar tu elección en cualquier momento borrando los datos del sitio en tu navegador, lo que hace que el banner vuelva a aparecer.

browserControls.title: 8. Controles del navegador
paragraphs: La mayoría de los navegadores permiten bloquear o eliminar cookies en su configuración de privacidad. Desactivar cookies esenciales impide iniciar sesión y las funciones de seguridad; desactivar cookies funcionales/analíticas no afecta el uso básico de la plataforma.

retention.title: 9. Cuánto tiempo las conservamos
paragraphs: Las cookies de sesión (access) expiran pocas horas después de emitidas. La cookie de renovación (refresh) dura hasta 30 días de inactividad. Las cookies funcionales/analíticas siguen el período predeterminado establecido por su respectivo proveedor (típicamente hasta 2 años, salvo revocación del consentimiento).

updatesContact.title: 10. Actualizaciones y contacto
paragraphs: Podemos actualizar esta política a medida que añadimos o quitamos tecnologías. Para dudas sobre cookies o para ejercer tus derechos de privacidad, consulta los canales de contacto en nuestra Política de Privacidad.

intro.lead_html: BlockMiner is a Play-to-Earn platform where you build and manage virtual mining farms to earn real POL tokens on Polygon. Install miners in racks, grow hashrate, and convert production into withdrawable crypto.
intro.card1_desc: Install machines and produce POL continuously
intro.card2_desc: Faucet, YouTube, check-in, games, tournaments and more
intro.card3_desc: Transfer POL to your Polygon wallet

economy.lead_html: BlockMiner operates with two tokens: POL (Polygon) for external payments and BLK as the platform's internal token. New trading pairs are planned on the roadmap.
economy.alert_manual_html: Payments are processed manually by the team within 72 business hours. Request a withdrawal and wait — no need to open a ticket.
economy.info_support: If the deadline is exceeded, open a support ticket with the amount and request date.

infra.lead_html: Your farm is organized as Rooms → Racks → Slots. Each room has 24 racks; each rack has 8 slots for miners. New rooms unlock progressively with POL.
infra.capacity_html: Maximum capacity: 4 rooms × 24 racks × 8 slots = 768 total slots after unlocking all rooms.

mining_room.intro: The heart of your operation. Here you view and manage all your racks.

items.install_text: Click an empty slot on a rack to open inventory and choose a machine.
items.rename_text: Click the rack name to customize it.
items.remove_text: Click an installed machine to remove it and return it to inventory.
items.clear_text: Removes all machines from the rack at once.
items.rooms_text: Appear locked. Pay in POL to unlock and expand your capacity.

double_slots.intro_html: High-performance miners occupy 2 consecutive slots. Plan your racks accordingly to make the most of the 8 available slots.

public_ranking.intro_html: Each operator has a Public Room accessible from the ranking. Visitors can see all racks and installed machines, but cannot edit.
public_ranking.hashrate_html: On the ranking, total hashrate includes: installed machines + GamePower (games) + YouTube bonus.

machines.lead_html: Each miner has hashrate and slot size set by the admin in the shop. Higher hashrate means more POL — but larger machines may occupy 2 consecutive slots on the rack.
machines.single_desc: Smaller machines. Up to 8 units per rack.
machines.double_desc: Larger machines (high hashrate). Each occupies 2 consecutive slots — up to 4 per rack.
machines.info: Name, image, hashrate, and slot size are configured by the admin per machine. Check specs in the shop before buying.

passive.title: 1. Passive Mining
passive.body_html: The main source. Miners installed in racks produce POL continuously, 24/7. Each H/s of hashrate is converted to tokens at the rate set by the admin.

faucet.title: 2. Free Faucet
faucet.body_html: Every 1 hour, visit the sponsor and claim a free miner. Faucet miners are added directly to your inventory.
faucet.permanent_text: equipment stays in inventory as a normal machine (does not expire)

youtube.title: 3. YouTube Rewards
youtube.body: Paste any YouTube video URL and earn hashrate while watching.
youtube.pause_warning: The player pauses when switching tabs — only active views count.
youtube.error_text: author blocked embed. Use "Open on YouTube" normally.

auto_mining.title: 4. Auto Mining
auto_mining.body_html: Keep the Auto Mining screen open and machines are claimed automatically every 5 minutes with no action required.
auto_mining.start_tip: Click start, keep the tab open, and the 5-minute timer runs on its own
auto_mining.gpu_tip: The available GPU is claimed and goes straight to inventory
auto_mining.tab_warning: Closing the tab stops the timer — keep Auto Mining visible

checkin.title: 5. Daily Check-in
checkin.body: Daily check-in with blockchain verification. The system generates a cryptographic proof to ensure authenticity.
checkin.tournaments_html: Contributes to scoring in Check-in Tournaments

missions.title: 6. Daily Missions
missions.body_html: Each day a set of missions is generated. Complete them for rewards (POL, BLK, miners, or hashrate boost).
missions.reset: Missions reset at midnight every day
missions.credit: Each completed mission is credited automatically to inventory

mini_pass.title: 7. Mini Pass (Season Pass)
mini_pass.body_html: The Mini Pass is a season pass with progressive rewards. Earn XP by using the platform normally and unlock prizes at each level.
mini_pass.xp: XP is earned from various activities: check-in, missions, faucet, etc.
mini_pass.rewards: Rewards for each level go straight to inventory when unlocked
mini_pass.season_warning: Each season has a deadline. XP does not carry over to the next season.

shortlinks.title: 8. Shortlinks
shortlinks.body: Visit partner shortened links and earn rewards. Each shortlink has a minimum dwell time before releasing the reward.

offerwall_internal.title: 9. Internal Offerwall
offerwall_internal.body: Offers created directly by the platform. Complete specific actions and receive immediate inventory rewards.
offerwall_internal.deadline: Offers with deadlines and completion limits
offerwall_internal.rewards: Varied rewards: POL, BLK, machines, or hashrate boost
offerwall_internal.tournaments_html: Count toward Offerwall ranking in Tournaments

offerwall_external.title: 10. External Offerwall
offerwall_external.body: External partners offer tasks (install apps, sign-ups, surveys) that pay POL on completion. Credits are recorded automatically after advertiser verification.
offerwall_external.vpn_warning: Use the same device and avoid VPN to prevent advertiser rejection
offerwall_external.support: Credit issues: open support with a screenshot of the completed offer

read_earn.title: 11. Read & Earn
read_earn.body: Read articles and content on the platform and earn rewards for each full read. The more you read, the more you accumulate.
read_earn.reward: Reward credited when you finish reading the article

games.title: 12. Games (GamePower)
games.body_html: The mini-game arena generates GamePower — temporary hashrate bonus added to your total ranking hashrate. The more you play, the higher your publicly displayed hashrate.

offers.title: 13. Limited Offers & Events
offers.body_html: Special events offer exclusive miners for a limited time. Watch the Offers section so you don't miss unique chances to expand your farm with rare equipment.
offers.expire: Offers expire on set dates — recurrence not guaranteed
offers.hashrate: May include miners with hashrate above what's available in the regular shop

tournaments.lead_html: Tournaments are automatic competitions where players compete on specific metrics. At the end, top placements receive prizes directly in inventory — no claim required.

metrics.hashrate: Snapshot of current total hashrate (machines + bonuses)
metrics.blocks: Total block rewards received in the period
metrics.checkins: Number of check-ins completed in the period
metrics.missions: Daily missions completed in the period
metrics.deposits: Sum of confirmed POL deposits in the period

tournaments.auto_join_html: Automatic entry: any account that accumulates score during the period is enrolled automatically — no entry fee.
tournaments.scores_info: Scores update every 5 minutes. The final leaderboard is consolidated when the tournament ends and prizes are sent automatically.
tournaments.tiers_html: Prizes are distributed by placement tiers (e.g. 1st–3rd, 4th–10th). Check prizes on the tournament page before it ends.

track.p1_html: In the Tournaments section, each card shows status (Active / Scheduled / Ended), the metric, and a countdown to the end.
track.p2_html: Click a tournament to open the top 100 leaderboard. Your position and current score appear separately if you are not in the top 100.

tournaments.history_html: In the same section, the My History tab lists every tournament you joined, your final placement, and whether you received a prize.

deposit_items.address: Copy or scan the platform's exclusive address
deposit_items.send_html: Send POL on the Polygon network to that address
deposit_items.hash: Paste the transaction hash and wait up to 5 min for confirmation
deposit_items.network_warning: Do not send via another network — funds will be lost

withdraw_items.connect: Connect your Web3 wallet (MetaMask, etc.) on Polygon
withdraw_items.amount: Enter destination address and amount (min. 10 POL)
withdraw_items.manual_html: Payment is processed manually within 72 business hours
withdraw_items.verify: Verify the address before confirming — transactions are irreversible

wallet.support_html: If the 72 business-hour deadline is exceeded, open a support ticket in Wallet with the amount and request date.
connect_steps: Install MetaMask or another EVM-compatible wallet in your browser
In the wallet, add the Polygon network (Chain ID: 137)
On the platform, go to Wallet and click "Connect Wallet"
Approve the connection in your wallet popup
If needed, click "Switch to Polygon" to change network automatically

info_rows.locked_rooms_value: Shown with a lock in the public room

ranking.tip_html: To compete specifically for hashrate prizes, join Tournaments — they measure hashrate over fixed periods with automatic reward distribution.
